about: Cases every implementation of Home must pass (spec/home.md). 'computer': what a computer holds (its boards, its agents as the agent list says them, the titles agents give their tiles, which agent started which, what the window's Layers panel shows of each workspace, and what each tile last said or showed), in; Home's rows by key, and each tile's last line by its row's key, out. 'phone': what the computer answers on the home stream, in order, in; the rows the phone holds after each, and how it groups and orders them, out.

computer.about: a workspace, its frames as structure gives them, in the board's order (a worktree under its frame, one on another machine), a top frame in another folder on this computer, or a worktree left with no frame above it, with that folder's project, and its tiles: named as the person named them, else as the agent's title says, else by label; listed where the Layers panel lists them, pinned ones marked, and those that run a terminal (an agent's or a shell), one the panel does not list after those in the board's order; under the agent that started it, when that is on this board; an agent's state, since, wait, program, machine, and whether it can be interrupted and read, as the agent list says; a tile in no frame; each tile's last line
a workspace the window shows nothing of: its tiles in the board's order, none pinned

phone.about: the whole: what waits on the person, the longest first; what is at work, the longest first; the pinned, in the desktop's order, and only there; then each machine (the computer first, then the others by name in any case, a heading each when there is more than one) and on it each workspace by name, its own project first, then each other in the order its first frame comes; in a project its frames in the board's order, a worktree under its frame, every frame though it has no tiles; in a frame its agents first (one the agent list tells of, though it names no agent), then its other tiles, each in the desktop's order, one an agent there started under it; tiles in no frame, or in one that is gone, after the workspace's own frames; each tile with its last line

searched: only the tiles whose name, agent or what runs it holds the words, in any case, and only the frames, projects and machines with one of them; one started by a tile left out is listed in its frame
one machine chosen: only what is on it, the pinned among it, a frame with none of its tiles left out, and no heading to say which

changes: none before the whole; then each after the position held, one at or before it ignored, a row said gone taken away though it is given, one that cannot be read taken away as one that went; each sequence's position its own, never moved back
changes before any whole: none held, nothing followed

read as the agent list is read: a row of a kind it does not know left out; a state it does not know, or one with no time, no state and no wait; a wait of a kind it does not know, or on a tile not waiting, none; what only a permission says not said of a question, what only a question says not said of a permission, and only true taken as true; a frame on a machine called as the computer is, on the computer

a project's only frame, called as the project is in any case and with no frame under it, is no row of its own: its tiles are the project's, one level up; a frame called otherwise, one with a frame under it, or one among others, stays
